_about: Chapter 6 (Travel): Daniela at gate (sala) 4 for flight 223: is this the gate, which flight, on time or delayed, questions, a seat change, the full-flight twist (free gate check of the carry-on), have a seat, the boarding call (zone 2 first), the scan. The gate-change twist has no id of its own and keeps the current picture.

items.prompt: Daniela, the gate agent, stands behind the gate desk about one third from the left, both hands resting on the desk, with a courteous smile as the learner walks up ("¡Buenos días! ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?").
Change only her pose and expression: she holds out one open hand, palm up, across the desk for the learner's boarding pass, eyebrows raised (which flight are you on?).

Change only her pose and expression: she glances at the slim watch on her wrist and gestures with her other hand toward the plane waiting outside the big window, with a reassuring smile (boarding at seven thirty).
Change only her pose and expression: she points off to the left with an open hand, toward the restrooms and the café down the hall, helpful and calm.
Change only her pose and expression: she has one hand on the keyboard and turns from the monitor to the learner with eyebrows raised and a helpful smile (shall I switch your seat?).
items.note: 5 Nov audit: remade (nearly the same as flight) as an edit of greet (Batch API); the audit manifest in the work folder's audit/ holds the prompt.

items.prompt: Change only her pose and expression: she holds up a blank paper bag tag with an elastic loop and gestures at a small carry-on roller bag standing on the floor by the desk (the flight is full: we're checking carry-ons for free).
Change only her pose and expression: she gestures with an open hand toward the rows of seats in the waiting area, a courteous smile (have a seat; we board by zone).

Change only her pose and expression: she leans toward a small microphone on a flexible stalk on the gate desk, one finger on its button, speaking as she looks out over the waiting area (the boarding call).

Change only her pose and expression: she shakes her head gently with an apologetic smile, one hand raised palm out (not yet: another zone first), while a few varied passengers with carry-ons line up beside the desk.

Change only her pose and expression: she holds a small handheld scanner over a blank boarding pass on the desk, a thin red line of light across it, and glances up at the learner with a courteous smile.
Change only her pose and expression: she gestures with an open hand toward the open door to the jet bridge on the left, smiling ("¡Buen vuelo!").
